records.context: Secretaries of State: State Papers Foreign, Prussia. Baron Raby and J. Powell. (Described at item level).
records.description: Folio 405: Raby to Harley. Correspondence received. At Queen Anne's request, Frederick I has consented to ban on duke of Mantua [Charles IV]. Marlborough's visit. Prussia uneasy following Swedish seizure of Izmajlov in Silesia; empire also condemns this act. No definite decision about route to be taken by troops marching to Italy; news from [Berlepsch] awaited. Court news. Raby thinks alleged Prussian-Swedish treaty must be a forgery. Princess R kóczi still hopes to see Frederick. Hint about Margrave Albert. Finances. Praise of the Treasury: `Queen Elizabeth's Burleigh is far out done by Queen Ann's Godolphin'. From Potsdam.

records.context: Secretaries of State: State Papers Foreign, Prussia. Baron Raby and J. Powell. (Described at item level).
records.description: Folio 411: Raby to Harley. Professions of Anglo-Prussian emnity by both sides. England will support Prussian pretensions as terms of a general peace. Court news. Prince of Anhalt to follow troops to Italy. [Berlepsch] has written that Count Levenstein [? i.e. Maximilian Charles, Count Lowenstein] will allow Prussian troops to march via Tyrol, to imperial resident's vexation. Swedes have released Izmajlov. Arrival of prince [Mauritius] of Saxe-Merseburg, complaining of ill-treatment by Augustus and hoping for imperial protection. Lintelo and family preparing to leave Berlin. Hint about Margrave Albert. From Potsdam.
